meta.name: competitor-social-research
meta.description: Use when the user wants to research competitors' social media strategy, compare brands or creators, find what content is working in a niche, identify content gaps, or produce a practical social strategy brief from public social data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把竞品社交数据变成可执行的策略简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要了解竞品在社交媒体上的打法
copy.tagline_en: Turn competitor social data into an actionable strategy brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to understand competitors' social media playbook

howto.what: 装好后,Claude会按流程抓取竞品在各社交平台的公开资料和近期内容,对比粉丝量、发帖频率、内容形式与互动,找出表现突出的帖子,并输出一份竞品社交研究简报,含差距分析和内容测试建议。
howto.when: 当用户要求研究竞品社媒策略、对比品牌/创作者、找出某个领域有效内容等时触发。

say.text: 对比我和A品牌在TikTok上的账号数据
say.note: 会抓取双方资料和帖子,生成对比表

say.text: 找出这个领域里哪些内容最受欢迎
say.note: 会按每个账号的中位数找异常爆款

say.text: 基于公开数据给我写一份竞品策略简报
say.note: 会输出含差距和测试建议的Markdown简报

howto.what_en: Claude fetches competitors' public profiles and recent posts, compares audience size, posting pace, formats and engagement, spots outliers per account, and outputs a brief with gaps and recommended tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to research competitors' social media strategy, compare brands or creators, find what content works in a niche, etc.

say_en.text: Compare my TikTok account with brand A's.
say_en.note: It will pull both profiles and posts, then show a comparison.

say_en.text: Find which content performs best in this niche.
say_en.note: It will look for outliers using each account's median baseline.

say_en.text: Write me a competitor strategy brief from public data.
say_en.note: It will output a Markdown brief with gaps and test ideas.
